updated_for: Current DoED operating-register authority, pinned DoED-NAXA operating point crossmatch, top-ten project overlay, official river/catchment authority registry, spatial CRS policy, and Kali Gandaki A naming correction
research_boundary: Only source-backed geography and source-backed project reference points are shown. Project points are not treated as full project footprints. River and basin authorities are now registered, but raw licensed hydrographic geometry and unverified catchment polygons are not republished as if they were open official vectors.
current_authority_context: The current DoED operating register used by this research system is dated 18 September 2026 and contains 217 operating hydropower projects. The point crossmatch is a separately pinned July 2026 reconciliation layer and must not be mistaken for a complete September operating register.
coordinate_rule: A map feature must describe what its coordinate or geometry actually represents. Project points, river centerlines and catchment polygons are separate geometry classes with separate provenance. Public/interchange geometry is normalized to EPSG:4326; metric queries use PostGIS geography or a verified projected CRS appropriate to the feature location.
kali_gandaki_correction: Kali Gandaki is the river/geographic name. Kali Gandaki A is a hydropower project/station. The highlighted 27.931, 83.6152 point is the powerhouse/generating-station point near Beltari/Yamgha, Syangja; the dam/headworks are upstream near Mirmi.

stored_registers.description: Governed September 18, 2026 DoED operating-register manifest: 217 operating entries, 211 with non-zero official geographic coordinate extents, and six zero-coordinate exclusions.

Governed manifest for the pinned July 2026 DoED-NAXA/local reconciliation layer: 201 local point records matched to DoED operating records, using raw NAXA/local coordinates as project reference points.
Ten-project emphasized overlay with project-specific coordinate provenance.
Official-source registry for Survey Department river hydrography, WECS river-basin framework and DHM hydrological attribution.
Relational identifiers for the ten WECS river basins plus Southern Blocks; polygon geometry remains pending governed vector admission.
CRS and spatial-query rules: EPSG:4326 canonical web geometry, Nepal 1981 reference context, three-zone Nepal TM/MUTM model, and metric-query policy.
PostGIS reference schema for river MultiLineString, catchment MultiPolygon, project-to-river/catchment links, source provenance and GiST indexes.
